mapper.select: SELECT ID, USER_NM, ENPSWD, ACNT_STTS_CD, AUTHRT_CD FROM ADMIN_MST WHERE ID = #{id}

SELECT R.RSVT_SN, R.RSVT_NO, R.SCHL_NM, R.SCYR_NM, R.RSVT_YMD, R.VST_HM, R.RSVT_NOPE, R.ACTL_NOPE, R.PRGRM_TYPE_CD, CASE R.PRGRM_TYPE_CD WHEN 'MISSION' THEN '미션' WHEN 'EXPLORE' THEN '사건탐구' ELSE R.PRGRM_TYPE_CD END AS PRGRM_TYPE_NM, R.PRGRM_SN, P.PRGRM_NM, P.TRGT_CN, P.TOTAL_TM_MNT, P.MAX_NOPE, P.SIMPLE_EXPLN, P.START_EXPLN, P.TEAM_CNT, P.ROUTE_JSON, P.STEP_JSON, P.EVAL_JSON, R.LRN_STTS_CD, CASE R.LRN_STTS_CD WHEN 'READY' THEN '진행 전' WHEN 'ING' THEN '진행 중' WHEN 'DONE' THEN '완료' ELSE R.LRN_STTS_CD END AS LRN_STTS_NM, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EDU_RSVT_STDNT S WHERE S.RSVT_SN = R.RSVT_SN AND S.DEL_DT IS NULL ) AS STDNT_CNT FROM EDU_RSVT_MST R LEFT JOIN EDU_PRGRM_MST P ON P.PRGRM_SN = R.PRGRM_SN AND P.PRGRM_TYPE_CD = R.PRGRM_TYPE_CD WHERE R.RSVT_YMD = #{rsvtYmd} AND R.DEL_DT IS NULL ORDER BY R.VST_HM DESC, R.RSVT_SN DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT STDNT_SN, RSVT_SN, STDNT_NO, CLAS_NM, CLAS_NO, STDNT_NM, ATND_YN, TEAM_NM, ASGN_NM, ROUTE_CN, LRN_STTS_CD, PRGRS_RT FROM EDU_RSVT_STDNT WHERE RSVT_SN = #{rsvtSn} AND DEL_DT IS NULL ORDER BY CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(STDNT_NO, ''), STDNT_SN) AS UNSIGNED), STDNT_SN
mapper.sql: C.CNTN_SN, C.CNTN_TYPE_CD, CASE C.CNTN_TYPE_CD WHEN 'INFO' THEN '정보안내' WHEN 'VIDEO' THEN '애니메이션 영상' WHEN 'SELECT' THEN '선택형 활동' WHEN 'DATA' THEN '데이터 입력' WHEN 'PHOTO' THEN '사진 업로드' WHEN 'SENTENCE' THEN '문장완성형' ELSE C.CNTN_TYPE_CD END AS CNTN_TYPE_NM, C.CARD_CLSF_CD, CASE C.CARD_CLSF_CD WHEN 'MISSION' THEN '미션카드' WHEN 'EXPLORE' THEN '탐구카드' WHEN 'EXPERIENCE' THEN '체험카드' WHEN 'DESIGN' THEN '설계활동' WHEN 'MAKER' THEN '메이커활동' ELSE C.CARD_CLSF_CD END AS CARD_CLSF_NM, C.CNTN_TTL, C.CNTN_CN, C.PRVD_TYPE_CD, CASE C.PRVD_TYPE_CD WHEN 'IMAGE' THEN '이미지' WHEN 'VIDEO' THEN '동영상' ELSE C.PRVD_TYPE_CD END AS PRVD_TYPE_NM, C.IMG_ATCH_FILE_ID, C.VIDEO_URL_ADDR, C.VIDEO_THMB_ATCH_FILE_ID, C.VIDEO_TTL
